# Merlign

> Merlign is a Dutch solo digital agency offering website development, custom dashboards, and automation services.

The founder works directly with entrepreneurs to provide practical digital tools without the overhead of a larger agency.

## Home
- [Home](https://merlign.com): Landing page introducing the agency and its services.

## About
- [About the Founder](https://merlign.com/over-mij): Profile of the founder and agency philosophy.

## Services
- [Website Development](https://merlign.com/website): Details on website creation delivered within two weeks.  
- [Custom Dashboards](https://merlign.com/dashboard): Information on building dashboards for business insights.  
- [Automation Services](https://merlign.com/automatisering): Overview of automation setups to save client time.

## Portfolio
- [Case Studies](https://merlign.com/cases): Examples of completed projects and outcomes.

## Contact
- [Contact](https://merlign.com/contact): Form and contact details for inquiries.
